required_documents.name: DOE Consolidated eXCHANGE Portal Registration
required_documents.details: Account registration on consolidated DOE eXCHANGE (exchange.energy.gov) required for submission.

required_documents.name: Alternative Feedstocks & Infrastructure Technical Narrative
required_documents.details: Detailed technical proposal focusing on one of three topic areas: stable biomass liquid intermediates, commodity chemicals from alternative feedstocks via existing refineries, or blended hydrogen-natural gas distribution pilots.

required_documents.name: Refinery and Pipeline Asset Integration Plan
required_documents.details: Engineering plan demonstrating how proposed technology harnesses existing domestic biomass, pipeline, or refinery assets.

required_documents.name: Pilot Site Safety and Network Reliability Protocol
required_documents.details: Safety and simulation protocol for testing hydrogen-natural gas blends or chemical intermediates under real-world operating conditions.

required_documents.name: DOE Budget Justification and Cost Share Commitment
required_documents.details: Itemized budget breakdown and binding non-federal cost share commitment letters from industry partners.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov Active UEI Registration
required_documents.details: Active Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) on SAM.gov prior to application.

eligibility.summary: Unrestricted. Open to domestic commercial entities, universities, research institutions, state agencies, and tribal organizations.

cost_share.details: Cost sharing will be required per standard DOE demonstration statutes (typically 20% for research/development and 50% for commercial pilot demonstrations).

review_criteria.criterion: Technical Merit and Innovation in Biomass/Feedstock Utilization
Feasibility of Integrating with Existing Pipeline and Refinery Infrastructure
Scalability, Reliability, and Commercial Pathway for Fuels and Chemicals

funded_activities.activity: Production of chemically, thermally, and physically stable liquid intermediate products from biomass for upgrading into renewable fuels and chemicals.
Production of commodity chemicals and fuels at market prices from alternative feedstocks leveraging existing refinery assets.
Establishing pilot sites for blended hydrogen-natural gas simulating gas distribution networks to evaluate reliability and durability.

submission_limits: Applicants may submit separate applications for distinct topic areas.
important_notes: Notice of Intent (NOI) only; applications will be accepted when the full NOFO DE-FOA-0003649 is officially released on exchange.energy.gov.
Specific dates, funding amounts, and topic requirements are subject to revision in the final NOFO.
